card.name: Linking words inside lists and instructions
card.fires_on: Small linking words or dashes (that, to, a, an, and, comma, hyphen) that sit at a join in a list or instruction, just before the next item or clause. Seen in general web text, not drug labels.

modes.label: Words before a described item
modes.description: A linking word or article such as that, a or an, right before the thing the instruction asks you to name.
modes.example: Now, think of a country<< that>> starts with the letter you're thinking of

modes.label: Joins in a series
modes.description: An and, to, comma or dash that joins items in an enumerated list or parallel clauses.
modes.example: (3) to proceed from the simple to the complex, and (4)<< to>> make sure nothing is left out.

card.plain: It fires on little connecting words and dashes that come just before the next item in a list or instruction.
